description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.84~0.96 each scaling with HP%), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000], [Combine Mode] to the user, grants [Dualcast Spellblade 1]/[Dualcast Spellblade 2]/[Dualcast Spellblade 3] to the user if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF9 allies are alive

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Combine Mode
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] to the character and Vivi after using two Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning damage
